narrative.intro: OptumServe Health Services has $1.9B in contract obligations for FY2026 to date. OptumServe Health Services has 11 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $170M. Obligations fell 26.3% year over year. The Department of Veterans Affairs is the largest buyer, accounting for $1.8B of obligations. The Department of Health and Human Services provided $11.5M and the Department of Defense provided $11M. Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) is the largest market at $1.8B. Offices of Physicians, Mental Health Specialists is $11M, All Other Outpatient Care Centers is $10.8M, and All Other Miscellaneous Ambulatory Health Care Services is $719K. Historical obligations show variation across fiscal years: FY21 was $756M, FY22 was $874M, FY23 was $711M, FY24 was $1.6B, FY25 was $2.5B, and FY26 is $1.9B. Current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date obligations rather than full-year totals.

sections.heading: How has OptumServe Health Services' federal business changed over time?
sections.body: OptumServe Health Services recorded obligations of $756M in FY21, $874M in FY22, $711M in FY23, $1.6B in FY24, $2.5B in FY25, and $1.9B in FY26. OptumServe Health Services' obligations fell 26.3% year over year into FY2026 to date. OptumServe Health Services' current-year totals are partial and reflect fiscal year to date obligations.

sections.heading: Where does OptumServe Health Services get most of its federal revenue?
sections.body: The Department of Veterans Affairs is the top buyer, obligating $1.8B to OptumServe Health Services in FY2026 to date. The Department of Health and Human Services obligated $11.5M and the Department of Defense obligated $11M. Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) is the dominant market at $1.8B in obligations.

faq.q: How much does OptumServe Health Services make from federal contracts?
faq.a: OptumServe Health Services makes $1.9B from federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. OptumServe Health Services has 11 awards this fiscal year and the average award size is $170M. Current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date obligations.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from OptumServe Health Services?
faq.a: The Department of Veterans Affairs buys most from OptumServe Health Services, with $1.8B in obligations. The Department of Health and Human Services obligated $11.5M and the Department of Defense obligated $11M in FY2026 to date.

faq.q: What does OptumServe Health Services sell to the government?
faq.a: OptumServe Health Services sells physician and outpatient health services to the government. Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) account for $1.8B, Offices of Physicians, Mental Health Specialists account for $11M, All Other Outpatient Care Centers account for $10.8M, and All Other Miscellaneous Ambulatory Health Care Services account for $719K in FY2026 to date.

faq.q: Which OptumServe Health Services contracts are expiring soon?
faq.a: OptumServe Health Services has no expiring-contract figures listed on this page. The available data lists current obligations, top buyers, markets, and fiscal year obligation history but does not provide expiring-contract values.
